easyPrerequisites: You haven't activated Kirol's ability this turn.
description:
Declare The Neutrinos as attackers, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Midnight Guard. copying The Neutrinos's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of The Neutrinos's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, The Neutrinos and Midnight Guard trigger.
Resolve the Midnight Guard trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Neutrinos trigger, giving it +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.
